focus: Tata Micron 3 Reach Trucks Battery Cannibalization & Plant Safety Grounding, 100ft Boom Lift (SES 9002) Harness Delay & Unreported JCB Tyre Tear, Bhadrak 125 Cutting Sensor Damaged Bushing, Pravesh Site 43-Machine Fleet Census & Hydraulic Oil Allocation (Reach vs Cross-Rent Priority), Guwahati Genie 125 Starting Issue & Local Starter Motor Repairs (₹2,500/unit), Ravikant Z-135 (SN: 142462) Card Power Supply Failure & 450 Gasket Fitment, Jamnagar Wiped Diagnostic Laptop Escalation, Ban on Unauthorized Machine Serial Plate Alterations & Central Master Cross-Reference Sheet, and Corporate 5TB Cloud Data Backup Architecture

breakdowns.site: Tata Micron Site (Sanand) — 3 Reach Trucks (SN: 2040 3362 518, 3362 413, 3240 3513 798) Grounded & Battery Cannibalization
breakdowns.issue: All 3 reach trucks grounded at Tata Micron plant. Client safety auditors inspected check-sheets and red-flagged the units as safety violations because batteries hold charge for barely 2 hours, forcing intermittent halting. Supervisor Dheeraj Dubey previously claimed machines were working, but client revoked operation permits. Dheeraj cited delays due to vehicle unloading and gate pass hurdles. 8 replacement batteries are in transit arriving tomorrow.
breakdowns.action: Dhruv Sharma and Jitendra Budhauliya strictly reprimanded Dheeraj for delaying battery swapping despite 4 consecutive meeting directives. Dheeraj ordered to immediately open battery banks on site, extract functional cells, and consolidate them into priority machines so at least 1–2 reach trucks resume operation within the hour. Technician Ambrish deployed to Micron to assist Dheeraj with gate passes, permits, and administrative backlog.
breakdowns.status: Mandatory Cell Swap Underway on Site; 8 Batteries in Transit (Arriving Tomorrow); Technician Ambrish Dispatched

breakdowns.site: Vinod / Banarsi Fleet — 100ft Boom Lift (SES 9002) 1-Month Harness Delay & Unreported Tyre Puncture/Accident Damage
breakdowns.issue: 100ft Boom Lift (SES 9002) has been awaiting a wiring harness replacement for over 1 month (logged in CRM and Google Form). Damaged wiring harness previously caused electronic control card failure. Additionally, Banarsi and Vinod requested tyre replacement, claiming machine came in 2022. Investigation revealed tyre was newly installed 6 months ago and sustained deep sidewall tearing from an on-site collision with a JCB / steel angle iron, which was kept hidden from management while operator communicated directly with Vinay.
breakdowns.action: Management strictly reprimanded Banarsi for lack of field accountability and communication gaps. Pardeep Tomar instructed to expedite SES 9002 wiring harness procurement. Banarsi ordered to inspect tyre damage, submit Google Form with serial plate photos within 10 minutes, and establish direct supervisory control over all machine operators.
breakdowns.status: Google Form & Damage Photos Ordered (10-Min Deadline); Harness Procurement Expedited; Operator Reporting Channel Rectified

breakdowns.site: Bhadrak Site — Machine 125 (25) Cutting Sensor Damage from Worn Bushing
breakdowns.issue: Machine 125 at Bhadrak suffered mechanical damage to its cutting sensor assembly caused by an excessively worn-out/cut bushing. Machine is operating impaired on only 2 cutting cycles, impacting site productivity.
breakdowns.action: Banarsi verified Google Form and CRM complaint submission, and posted photos to the breakdown group. Central store (Pardeep Tomar) instructed to expedite dispatch of replacement cutting sensor and bushing kit.
breakdowns.status: CRM Ticket & Google Form Verified; Photos Logged; Replacement Sensor & Bushing Dispatch in Progress

breakdowns.site: Pravesh Operational Site — 43-Machine Fleet Census, Hydraulic Oil Allocation & Cross-Rent Servicing Protocol
breakdowns.issue: Payment of ₹21,500 required for local hydraulic oil purchase (receiving voucher pending from Kaushal). Site fleet census stands at 43 machines: 35 JCB scissors, 6 JCB booms, 2 JLG booms (153/135), comprising 30 cross-rent machines and 13 Reach-owned machines. Site received 2 drums of hydraulic oil (Grade 32 and Grade 68) from central yard. Machines also lack Reach asset stickers (Pravesh using paper markers).
breakdowns.action: Dinesh and Sushil Mishra issued strict directive: Dispatched hydraulic oil must be used exclusively to service Reach's 13 company-owned machines first. Cross-rent machines (30 units) will only be serviced after cross-rent vendor clearances and payment confirmations are formalized. Pravesh assigned personal accountability for every liter of oil (all dispenses must be logged in CRM to prevent leakage/theft). Machine stickers arriving with next spares consignment.
breakdowns.status: ₹21,500 Payment Verification Underway; 2 Oil Drums (Grade 32 & 68) Received; Own-Machine Servicing Prioritized over Cross-Rent

breakdowns.site: Guwahati / Northeast Fleet — Genie 125 Starting Defect, 2-Month Overdue Fleet Servicing & Starter Motor Repair
breakdowns.issue: Genie 125 had a starting failure; starter motor was replaced yesterday by Vinod, but neither supervisor Subhash nor Vinod registered the breakdown in CRM. Subhash found sitting in room at 10:30 AM making excuses about mobile restrictions. Entire site fleet (including 150ft and 135ft booms) is ~2 months overdue for periodic maintenance, running on degraded/burnt oil and clogged filters.
breakdowns.action: Dhruv and Jitendra reprimanded Subhash. Subhash ordered to compile a handwritten master service chart listing each machine's serial number, current hour meter reading, and last service date/hours, and submit it today. Subhash instructed to log all CRM tickets during daily room intervals.
breakdowns.status: Genie 125 Started; Handwritten Fleet Maintenance & Hour Meter Dossier Ordered Today; CRM Backlog Reconciliation Enforced

breakdowns.site: Guwahati Workshop Depot — Local Starter Motor Refurbishment Program (4 Units)
breakdowns.issue: 4 failed starter motors accumulating on site. 1 unit is completely burnt out (unrepairable scrap), while 3 units have repairable faults (worn carbon brushes, grounding issues, commutator wear).
breakdowns.action: Management rejected shipping unrepairable scrap to Delhi yard. Subhash directed to take the 3 repairable units to Guwahati local electrical workshop (cost approx ₹2,500 each for carbon brush/grounding overhaul). Supervisor must record estimated repair costs on paper, post to group, stamp repaired units with 'R' and repair date, and store as site buffer. Completely burnt starter to be quarantined/dispatched as scrap.
breakdowns.status: 3 Units Approved for Local Electrical Reconditioning (₹2,500 est.); 1 Unit Condemned; Repair Dates ('R-Date') to be Stamped on Bodies

breakdowns.site: Ravikant / Praveen Fleet — Machine Z-135 (SN: 142462) Electronic Card Power Lockout & Machine 450 Gasket Fitment
breakdowns.issue: Genie Z-135 (SN: 142462) grounded with complete electrical failure; technician Praveen diagnosed zero power supply reaching the control card, requiring diagnostic laptop connection. Serial number 142462 was missing from the CRM database. On Machine 450, engine gasket replacement was pending.
breakdowns.action: Ravikant delivered replacement engine gasket to Praveen to complete Machine 450 assembly today. Jitendra instructed to verify machine serial number 142462, check serial plate photo on breakdown group, and register the unit into CRM immediately. Laptop connectivity to be arranged locally or via regional team.
breakdowns.status: Machine 450 Gasket Fitment in Progress; SN 142462 CRM Entry Being Registered; Z-135 Control Card Diagnostics Underway

breakdowns.site: Jamnagar Fleet — JCB T65 Diagnostic Tooling Dispatch Blunder (Formatted Laptop)
breakdowns.issue: Diagnostic laptop dispatched to Jamnagar for technician Pradeep Suthar arrived completely wiped/formatted, lacking JCB Service Master diagnostic software. Pradeep spent entire morning struggling to download massive software packages over slow site connection, stalling JCB T65 boom lift calibration.
breakdowns.action: Dhruv reprimanded Dinesh and yard tech team for gross negligence in sending unverified hardware to remote sites. Dinesh instructed to coordinate remote setup assistance and ensure future diagnostic dispatches are pre-installed and field-tested before courier handover.
breakdowns.status: JCB Service Master Download in Progress at Jamnagar; Tool Dispatch Pre-Verification Protocol Enforced

breakdowns.site: Micron & Agras Fleet Support — Deepak Jangra & Dheeraj Dubey Coordination & CG Power 4550
breakdowns.issue: Communication breakdown between supervisor Dheeraj and technician Deepak led to vehicle detention penalties (₹3,000 transporter demurrage) and delayed maintenance. Deepak resolved minor issues (lights, horn, loose smoking battery terminal) on 4–6 vehicles at Agras yesterday. At CG Power, a 4550 scissor lift on the 2nd floor developed an operational defect.
breakdowns.action: Dhruv and Jitendra ordered end to internal finger-pointing. Deepak directed to report to CG Power immediately to inspect Machine 4550 with Khemchand. Dheeraj instructed to provide daily work plans to technicians, manage gate passes proactively, and post all breakdowns to WhatsApp group and CRM.
breakdowns.status: Deepak Mobilized to CG Power for Machine 4550; Agras 4–6 Machines Cleared; Demurrage Penalties Flagged for Administrative Review

directives.title: Strict Prohibition of Unauthorized Machine Serial Plate Alterations & Mandatory Master Cross-Reference Dossier
points: Total Ban on Plate Swapping: Field teams, clients, and technicians are strictly barred from removing, replacing, or altering machine serial number plates on sites (flagged across ~20–22 units at Mundra, Madurai, Amrapali, Z-135, Z-45).

Central Master Reconciliation Sheet: Jitendra Budhauliya and Pradeep Tomar must immediately compile a unified Master Spreadsheet documenting: (1) Original OEM Chassis Serial Number, (2) Modified/Client Serial Plate Number, (3) Internal Reach Asset Number (e.g. B-102, 506), and (4) Site Location.

Dual CRM Display: In CRM, all modified machines must carry the original chassis serial number in brackets alongside client plate numbers so tickets, parts requisitions, and service histories remain fully traceable.

directives.title: Deployment of Centralized 5TB Corporate Cloud Storage (Google One / Cloud Backup)
points: Prevention of Hardware Loss: Prompted by Shiv's laptop motherboard/SSD crash (loss of 2–2.5 GB/TB fleet records), Reach is transitioning from local physical hard drives to an enterprise cloud backup solution.
18-Month 5TB Free Tier: Jitendra's verified 5TB cloud space will be integrated under an official corporate master Google account.

Departmental Drive Structure: Dedicated automated sync folders will be created for Shiv Uniyal (Management), Pradeep Tomar (Store/Parts), Jitendra Budhauliya (Fleet Operations), and Dhruv Sharma (Executive), ensuring continuous background backup of all fleet spreadsheets, manuals, and CRM data.

directives.title: Clear Division Between Reach-Owned Fleet and Cross-Rent Asset Maintenance
points: Reach Fleet Priority: On mixed sites (such as Pravesh's 43-machine yard with 13 Reach units and 30 cross-rent units), company-supplied consumables like hydraulic oil (Grades 32 & 68) and critical spares must be utilized 100% on Reach's own machines first.

Strict Cross-Rent Prerequisite: Cross-rent equipment maintenance and oil consumption will only be permitted after explicit written authorization from Dinesh / Mishra Sir confirming vendor payment clearance and contractual obligations.

directives.title: Mandatory Field Logging Discipline — 'Zero Tickets Pending Overnight'
points: End of In-Room Idle Time: Technicians and supervisors (flagged with Subhash, Vinod, Dheeraj) must not sit idle in rooms during site hours.
Multi-Session CRM Logging: Supervisors must utilize room breaks (morning pre-departure, lunch, evening return) to log all breakdown tickets, hour meter readings, and parts requisitions in CRM.
100% Photo Documentation: Every mechanical failure, tyre cut, or damaged component must be photographed with clear serial plate visibility and posted to the official WhatsApp Breakdown Group.

directives.title: Demurrage & Gate Pass Administrative Accountability
points: Penalty Recovery: Transporter detention fees and truck demurrage charges (e.g. ₹3,000 penalties at Micron/Agras) caused by lack of coordination or failure to secure advance gate passes will be audited and surcharged to responsible supervisory staff.
Advance Gate Pass Protocol: Gate pass renewals must be initiated 10 days before expiry; technicians must punch daily to prevent automatic cancellation under client 30-day non-activity safety rules.
